final_message:
I added all three views to `notebooks/explore.py`. Each has a hypothesis cell before it and a facts cell after it. The notebook passes `marimo check` and runs from start to finish without errors (checked with an HTML export). There was no live marimo session running, so I edited the file directly. You didn't name a hunch for each view, so I wrote neutral hypotheses from your request; change them if you meant something more specific.

1. **`shipments_per_month`**: a line chart of monthly shipment counts.
   - There are 1,199 shipments from Jan 2023 to Dec 2024.
   - In 2023, April–June ran 54/55/50, about the same as the other quarters' average (+3.0%).
   - In 2024, April–June ran 35/41/39, 25.3% below the other quarters' average.
   - Oct–Dec 2023 is also low (45/41/42).

2. **`q2_dip_by_port`**: bars by port and year comparing April–June shipments with the average of the other three quarters.
   - In 2024, three ports show large drops: Fennick (−79.7%), Ivelholm (−77.8%) and Brackwater (−63.8%). Together they had 15 shipments in April–June 2024, against 57 the year before.
   - Each port only has 4–25 shipments a quarter, so these percentages move a lot on small changes.

3. **`q2_dip_by_carrier_type`**: the same comparison by carrier type.
   - In 2024: container −28.5% (26 shipments below its average), tanker −44.3% (10 below) and bulk −6.1% (2 below).

I left each facts cell at the numbers only. Once you've looked at the views, tell me your verdict on each and I'll add it to the facts cells in your words.

return (shipments,)


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    ## Shipments per month

    **Hypothesis.** Shipment volume drops in the second quarter.
    **Outcome:** monthly shipment counts for April–June sit below the other months of the same year.
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def shipments_per_month(mo, pl, shipments):
    import altair as alt

    _monthly = (
        shipments
        .group_by(pl.col('ship_date').dt.truncate('1mo').alias('month'))
        .agg(pl.len().alias('shipments'))
        .sort('month')
        .collect()
    )
    shipments_per_month = mo.ui.altair_chart(
        alt.Chart(_monthly)
        .mark_line(point=True)
        .encode(
            x=alt.X('month:T', title='Month'),
            y=alt.Y('shipments:Q', title='Shipments'),
            tooltip=['month:T', 'shipments:Q'],
        )
        .properties(width='container', height=300)
    )
    shipments_per_month
    return alt, shipments_per_month


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    **Facts.** 1,199 shipments, 2023-01-01 to 2024-12-31 (24 months).

    - Monthly counts range from 35 (Apr 2024) to 60 (Mar 2023).
    - 2023: Q2 months are 54, 55, 50. Q2 total is 159 vs. a 154.3 average for the other quarters (+3.0%).
    - 2024: Q2 months are 35, 41, 39. Q2 total is 115 vs. a 154.0 average for the other quarters (−25.3%).
    - Q4 2023 is also low: 45, 41, 42.
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    ## Second-quarter dip by port

    **Hypothesis.** The Q2 dip is concentrated in a few ports.
    **Outcome:** for each port and year, Q2 shipments compared with the average of the other three quarters. A few ports show a large negative gap and the rest stay near zero.
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def q2_dip_by_port(alt, mo, pl, shipments):
    _by_port = (
        shipments
        .with_columns(
            pl.col('ship_date').dt.year().alias('year'),
            pl.col('ship_date').dt.quarter().eq(2).alias('q2'),
        )
        .group_by('port', 'year')
        .agg(
            pl.col('q2').sum().alias('q2_shipments'),
            pl.col('q2').not_().sum().truediv(3).alias('other_quarter_avg'),
        )
        .with_columns(
            pl.col('q2_shipments')
            .truediv(pl.col('other_quarter_avg'))
            .sub(1)
            .alias('q2_vs_other'),
        )
        .sort('port', 'year')
        .collect()
    )
    q2_dip_by_port = mo.ui.altair_chart(
        alt.Chart(_by_port)
        .mark_bar()
        .encode(
            y=alt.Y('port:N', title='Port', sort='x'),
            x=alt.X('q2_vs_other:Q', title='Q2 vs. other-quarter average', axis=alt.Axis(format='%')),
            yOffset='year:N',
            color=alt.Color('year:N', title='Year'),
            tooltip=[
                'port:N',
                'year:N',
                'q2_shipments:Q',
                alt.Tooltip('other_quarter_avg:Q', format='.1f'),
                alt.Tooltip('q2_vs_other:Q', format='.1%'),
            ],
        )
        .properties(width='container', height=400)
    )
    q2_dip_by_port
    return (q2_dip_by_port,)

    | Hollowmere | 12 vs 14.7 (−18.2%) | 12 vs 12.0 (0.0%) |
    | Cindervale | 17 vs 13.0 (+30.8%) | 17 vs 14.7 (+15.9%) |
    | Glassford | 13 vs 13.0 (0.0%) | 12 vs 10.3 (+16.1%) |
    | Juniper Reach | 11 vs 14.0 (−21.4%) | 13 vs 10.3 (+25.8%) |

    - Fennick, Ivelholm and Brackwater sum to 15 Q2 shipments in 2024, against 57 in 2023.
    - The per-port counts are small (4–25 per quarter).
    """)

@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):

    """)

@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def q2_dip_by_carrier_type(alt, mo, pl, shipments):
    _by_carrier = (
        shipments
        .with_columns(
            pl.col('ship_date').dt.year().alias('year'),
            pl.col('ship_date').dt.quarter().eq(2).alias('q2'),
        )
        .group_by('carrier_type', 'year')
        .agg(
            pl.col('q2').sum().alias('q2_shipments'),
            pl.col('q2').not_().sum().truediv(3).alias('other_quarter_avg'),

        .with_columns(
            pl.col('q2_shipments')
            .truediv(pl.col('other_quarter_avg'))
            .sub(1)
            .alias('q2_vs_other'),
        )
        .sort('carrier_type', 'year')
        .collect()
    )
    q2_dip_by_carrier_type = mo.ui.altair_chart(
        alt.Chart(_by_carrier)
        .mark_bar()
        .encode(
            y=alt.Y('carrier_type:N', title='Carrier type'),
            x=alt.X('q2_vs_other:Q', title='Q2 vs. other-quarter average', axis=alt.Axis(format='%')),
            yOffset='year:N',
            color=alt.Color('year:N', title='Year'),
            tooltip=[
                'carrier_type:N',

                'q2_shipments:Q',
                alt.Tooltip('other_quarter_avg:Q', format='.1f'),
                alt.Tooltip('q2_vs_other:Q', format='.1%'),
            ],
        )
        .properties(width='container', height=200)
    )
    q2_dip_by_carrier_type
    return (q2_dip_by_carrier_type,)
